cy-4Jsq.title: Sign: British-style signs and road lines
cy-4Jsq.summary: A former British colony, it still uses British-style signs and road lines. This is also why it drives on the left and English is widely used.

cy-7IFu.title: Landscape: hilly, highest in the centre
cy-7IFu.summary: On a small island, terrain is the best way to narrow down your spot. Most of it is hilly to mountainous, and the centre is highest.

cy-8xv2.title: Sign: four-digit postal codes on street signs
cy-8xv2.summary: Street signs show four-digit postal codes marked T.K. or T.T. The codes are grouped by region, so the first digits are worth learning.

cy-E5gR.title: Roads: A, B, E, F letters by first digit
cy-E5gR.summary: Roads are labelled A, B, E or F and grouped by their first digit. E and F roads are near the B road with the same first digit, and B roads are easier to find.

cy-GraQ.title: Houses: white cylinder water tank on roof
cy-GraQ.summary: Houses often have a white, horizontal, cylindrical water tank with a round lid near one end on top.

cy-H1jq.title: Landscape: flat, red fields, low-quality camera
cy-H1jq.summary: The far east is mostly flat with lots of red fields. All coverage there is the old low-quality camera, which is rare in the rest of the island.

cy-HQht.title: Phone numbers: area codes starting with 2
cy-HQht.summary: Each of the 5 provinces has a two-digit area code starting with 2.

cy-IsTg.title: Bollard: none in forest reserve
cy-IsTg.summary: A forest reserve in the west has winding mountain roads with red soil beside them, mostly empty Mediterranean forest. You will almost never see bollards there.

cy-JQb2.title: Landscape: Mediterranean, pines in mountains
cy-JQb2.summary: Bright bare rock, olive, palm and cypress trees, and green farmland on the coast. The mountains inland have pine forests.

cy-Ls03.title: Pole: tall, dark brown wood
cy-Ls03.summary: Mostly wooden poles, quite tall and dark brown. Greek poles look the same.

cy-LzpI.title: Language: Greek and English
cy-LzpI.summary: Greek and English are both used. Greek letters have softer, rounder shapes than Cyrillic. Greece uses Greek too, so check the other clues.

cy-MDsc.title: Coverage: snowy roads
cy-MDsc.summary: A few roads were filmed in snow, southeast of the island label near the Panagia Machaira monastery.

cy-PP9D.title: Landscape: red soil inland and northwest
cy-PP9D.summary: Reddish soil is found inland and in the northwest.

cy-QTeI.title: Landscape: mountain ridge north of flat farmland
cy-QTeI.summary: In the northeast you can often see a long mountain ridge to the north, above otherwise flat farmland.

cy-RNMJ.title: Google car: low-mounted small camera, round blur
cy-RNMJ.summary: A low-mounted camera with a fairly big round blur and a small bump at the front. Sometimes the blur is see-through, with a short antenna visible at the back.

differs.how: Greece has this camera too but never shows an antenna

cy-SpqU.title: Plate: white EU or UK-style yellow rear
cy-SpqU.summary: Both white EU-style plates and UK-style plates with a yellow rear are used. Most have the EU strip on the left. Red plates on rental cars are common.

differs.how: UK plates have no EU strip and no red rental plates

cy-SuER.title: Driving side: left
cy-SuER.summary: Traffic drives on the left. Malta also drives on the left.

cy-Suab.title: Sign: shop signs also in Russian
cy-Suab.summary: About 17% of people speak Russian, so many shop signs in Limassol have Russian translations.

cy-XIJd.title: Plants: banana plantations on west coast
cy-XIJd.summary: Banana plantations grow along the west coast, around Peyia.

cy-ZlY6.title: Road lines: dashed blue between edge and centre
cy-ZlY6.summary: A few roads around Mount Olympus have dashed blue lines between the edge and centre markings.

cy-blro.title: Bollard: red front, white back, slanted top
cy-blro.summary: Red reflector at the front, white at the back, and a triangular post with a slanted top. Looks like the Turkish bollard, but that one is flat.

differs.how: Turkish bollards are flat, not triangular

cy-d6AJ.title: Landscape: turbines on sandy hills, fields
cy-d6AJ.summary: The eastern wind turbines are on sandy rolling hills surrounded by farm fields.

cy-e6Mi.title: Sign: town entry with speed limit above
cy-e6Mi.summary: Town entry signs are either a yellow rectangle with a red border or a small white rectangle, with the name in Greek and English and a speed limit sign above. This design is unique.

cy-gtvS.title: Plants: vineyards in the southwest
cy-gtvS.summary: Vineyards are more common towards the southwest.

cy-ilC2.title: Bollard: black top
cy-ilC2.summary: A different bollard with a black top, similar to Slovenia's, appears sometimes in the north-east. Normal local bollards can be there too.

differs.how: similar black-topped bollard, so use landscape to separate

cy-kCS4.title: Plants: bushes of yellow wild mustard
cy-kCS4.summary: Wild mustard looks like bushes of yellow flowers. It grows almost everywhere but is most common in the eastern half.

cy-lRj5.title: Landscape: turbines on shrubby hill, slope to coast
cy-lRj5.summary: The south-west turbines are on a shrubby hill in a forest, with steeper land around. The ground clearly slopes down towards the coast, often visible to the southwest.

cy-mLLv.title: Houses: bright painted stone, tiled or flat roof
cy-mLLv.summary: Most buildings are brightly painted stone with a tiled or flat roof. Greek buildings look similar.

cy-n354.title: Landscape: bright limestone on south coast
cy-n354.summary: Bright bare limestone is a good clue for the country, but it is mostly found along the south coast.

cy-n4db.title: Landscape: dark red fields
cy-n4db.summary: Dark red fields, even if covered in plants, point to the north and the far east of the island.

cy-qUjp.title: Sign: direction signs, Greek in all-caps
cy-qUjp.summary: Direction signs look like Greek ones, but the Greek text is written in all capitals.

differs.how: Greek signs do not use all-caps Greek text

cy-tgbp.title: Coverage: southern half of the island only
cy-tgbp.summary: Only the southern half of the island is covered, including the two British base areas.

cy-zbcn.title: Landmark: wind turbines in two clusters
cy-zbcn.summary: Wind turbines sit in two clusters: west of Larnaca in the east, and southwest of Anogyra near the Limassol-Paphos border.

cy-zqFQ.title: Pole: three kinds of top
cy-zqFQ.summary: Three pole tops: a crossbar with zero or three insulators, five insulators on the side, or a metal frame shaped like a harp. All also exist in Greece, but the symmetrical three-insulator top is only here.

differs.how: symmetrical three-insulator top is only found in Cyprus
